actual_trace_scope: Hierarchical actual traces emit shallow C-json header/node/child groups plus exact recursive delimiters; no complete actual trace copy or output string. Generic synthetic objects without hierarchy are deliberately small and C-encoded as bounded whole objects; no unrestricted large generic JSON memory claim.
buffer_scope: Largest emitted group is measured in each complete byte receipt. No fixed64KiB or hard token/group cap;512MiB retrospective worker+owner gate remains authoritative.
fingerprint_scope: V2 full-reference and full-repaired helpers both compare every original byte; canonical result field is explicitly labeled full original compact JSON fingerprint, not sorted canonical serialization.
activation_scope: Controlled owner enforces activation-v2.json. Direct pure worker CLI is technically callable; root owns all actual execution.
